language_shifts.shift: Cyclical risk expanded to include 'our client s vulnerability to downturns, which may result in decreased capital investment or expenditures and reduced demand for our services' — broadening headwind scope beyond prior language which only referenced the company's own vulnerability
New government contracts risk added: 'Uncertainties, restrictions and regulations impacting our government contracts' — absent in Q1-Q3, signaling emerging government sector execution exposure

Competition risk escalated mid-year: prior language 'place downward pressure on our contract prices and profit margins' extended with 'and may increase our contractual risks' — mid-year addition outside the annual 10-K cycle

Contract cost and schedule estimation risk elevated to the #1 position in the risk factor list, displacing the cyclical market risk that led Q1-Q5; language expanded to include 'those related to project delays'

Annual report reference changed to include 'as adjusted' qualifier: 'Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2017, as adjusted' — absent in all prior quarters, indicating a restatement of the 2017 10-K financials

red_flags: Revenue stagnated in the $4.7B-$4.9B range across all 6 quarters despite forward-looking language implying projected revenue growth
Energy & Chemicals segment revenue declined in both Q4 (Q1 2018) and Q5 (Q2 2018) with no reversal, representing a persistent structural decline
2017 Annual Report described as 'as adjusted' in Q6 (filed 2018-11-01) — indicates a prior-period restatement undisclosed in earlier quarterly filings
Contract cost and schedule estimation risk elevated to #1 priority in Q6 disclosures, suggesting realized or anticipated contract execution problems
Multiple segments (Mining, IIP, Energy & Chemicals) reported revenue declines in Q4 2018 while only Government and Diversified Services grew

new_risks.key_phrase: Uncertainties, restrictions and regulations impacting our government contracts

escalated_risks.risk: Contract cost and schedule estimation failure
escalated_risks.prior_language: Difficulties or delays incurred in the execution of contracts, or failure to accurately estimate the resources and time necessary for our contracts, resulting in cost overruns or liabilities
escalated_risks.current_language: Failure to accurately estimate the cost and schedule for our contracts, resulting in cost overruns or liabilities, including those related to project delays and those caused by the performance of our clients, subcontractors, suppliers and joint venture or teaming partners

escalated_risks.prior_language: Intense competition in the global engineering, procurement and construction industry, which can place downward pressure on our contract prices and profit margins
escalated_risks.current_language: Intense competition in the global engineering, procurement and construction industry, which can place downward pressure on our contract prices and profit margins and may increase our contractual risks

escalated_risks.risk: Cyclical market and client capital spending vulnerability
escalated_risks.prior_language: The cyclical nature of many of the markets the company serves, including our commodity-based business lines, and our vulnerability to downturns
escalated_risks.current_language: The cyclical nature of many of the markets the company serves, including our commodity-based business lines, and our and our client s vulnerability to downturns, which may result in decreased capital investment or expenditures and reduced demand for our services

disappeared_risks.risk: Client cancellations of or scope adjustments to existing contracts and the related impacts on staffing levels and cost
Liabilities arising from faulty services that could result in significant professional or product liability, warranty or other claims
Current economic conditions affecting clients, partners, subcontractors and suppliers resulting in decreased capital investment or expenditures

topics_dropped: Client cancellations as a distinct standalone risk category
Faulty services and product liability as a standalone risk
Current economic conditions affecting client capital spending as standalone concern
Difficulties or delays in execution as distinct from estimation failures
MMAI (Maintenance, Modification and Asset Integrity) segment identity — rebranded as Diversified Services without substantive explanation

notable_shifts.observation: Risk boilerplate updated with new reference to 2017 10-K; risk factor count reduced from 31 to 29 with three risks consolidated or removed while one new government contracts risk was added; cyclical risk language broadened to include client-side capital spending impacts

Competition risk language escalated mid-year with 'and may increase our contractual risks' — mid-year escalation outside of annual 10-K cycles signals active management concern about contract terms and margin compression

Annual 10-K reference carries 'as adjusted' qualifier signaling a restatement of fiscal year 2017 financials; contract cost and schedule estimation elevated to the #1 risk factor position, displacing the cyclical market risk that held the top position in Q1-Q5
